svg.title: Lifed — Program page icon library
svg.text: One icon per meaning, across every section of a program page. Two program types share the same set.
Lucide 0.544 · 24 × 24 grid · 1.7px stroke · round caps & joins · fill: none · stroke: currentColor
Sessions only, no overnight stay. The sun over a horizon line reads as
a single day, bounded start to finish. Teal is its accent colour.
Stay-inclusive, one or more nights on site. The same roofline as the day
mark, holding a moon: the program continues after dark. Leaf accent.
The strip under the program title, and the details list in the booking panel.
One category, one delivery mode, one booking format per program.
Session mechanics for programs that start and finish the same day.
Stay, room and arrival detail: itinerary, accommodation and packing list.
What happens in the program and what the price covers.
Day programs show refreshments; residential programs show full board.
One icon locked to one outcome across the whole catalogue.
Setting highlights and location. Residential adds property-level icons.
Audience chips in the overview block, and group size in booking.
Verification, credentials, reviews and the non-clinical notice.
The sticky panel and checkout. Reassurance icons sit at 16px.
Interface controls: the only icons allowed without a visible label.
